title: He Could Not Solve His Own Cube
description: Ernő Rubik, a Hungarian sculptor and professor of architecture, invented the Rubik's Cube in 1974. It was originally called the Magic Cube. According to later recollections, it took him about a month of trial and error to solve his own creation. It was released internationally in 1980 and was inducted into the US National Toy Hall of Fame in 2014. Source: Wikipedia, Rubik's Cube.
